description: Negative control: clean copy that also carries every known false-positive trap (comparative 'would rather ... than', 'the features' as a noun, 'their offers' as a noun, a plain 'is not a ...' negation, 'Nottingham', an unspaced en dash in 'Tiers 1-3', straight quotes, a proper-noun heading). Every count must be zero and the exit status must be 0. Guards against a linter that flags everything.
